question: Why can using array index as a React key break controlled inputs in a sortable list?
shortAnswer: Index keys can reuse the wrong component state after reorder.
strongAnswer: Keys identify siblings across renders. If items reorder but keys stay positional indexes, React may attach existing state/DOM to the wrong item, so input text appears to jump rows.
advancedAnswer: Compare intentional remount-via-key for resetting state versus stable business IDs for list identity; mention reconciliation goals.
commonWrongAnswer: Keys are only for performance and never affect state.
